issues.title: fix unpacked to packed parameter assignment
issues.summary: Issue #6088 reports a bug where unpacked arrays being assigned to packed array parameters produce incorrect results. The fix in PR #6081 removed code from V3Const.cpp that was causing 16-bit constants to be widthed to 8-bit. However, the test case from PR (test.v) passes on all tested versions including v5.036 (before fix). This suggests either: 1) The test case was designed to verify the fix rather than demonstrate the original bug, 2) The bug only manifests under specific conditions not covered by this test case, or 3) The bug was fixed before v5.036. Further investigation would be needed to find a test case that actually reproduces the bug.
